instructions:
IRIN is a local-first mono-repo: council-rs/ (deliberation engine + War Room Web + Tauri shell), gateway/ (OpenResty Lua + Rust sidecar: routing, signing, watch), sentinel/ (sovereign-protocol wire + docs). Also review Bash release/packaging scripts, GitHub Actions workflows, and CI control-plane scripts when they change.

Surface candidate issues for a maintainer to judge; do not claim merge approval, install acceptance, or publication.

This codebase is often agent-authored. Prioritize these defect classes:
1. Inert logic: guards, gates, validators, or filters that can never fire; verify producer and consumer agree on real keys/schema/names.
2. Resource ownership: callee closing caller-owned handles; broken ownership in finally/defer paths.
3. Fail-open error paths: catch/except that swallows errors and returns success where fail-closed is required.
4. Cross-file self-consistency: constants, paths, env names, or proof hooks that nothing else reads or writes.
5. Secrets: credentials live outside source (operator config/env). Flag hardcoded keys/tokens/credentials; never instruct printing or reading secret material during review.
6. Prefer the authoritative existing product path; flag parallel workflows, compatibility shims, and duplicated state machines when the existing path can own the behavior.
7. Verify producer/consumer, caller/callee, and proof-wiring relationships — not only the changed lines.

Deprioritize style nits, naming preferences, and docstring completeness. IRIN already has deterministic format/lint/test proof.

Do not recommend live provider smokes, signing/arming against real keys, publication workflows, or credential-bearing actions.

rules.rule: Preserve public, wire, and storage contracts unless the PR explicitly changes them. Field add/remove/rename, envelope version bumps, signing/capability-token changes, and on-disk ledger shapes need an explicit callout for human review. Do not assert adjacent components are safe.

Comms-spine wire shapes (envelope irin.comms.v0.1, directive outbox signing, capability tokens, escalation/directive shapes) are contracts. Any field add/remove/rename, signing change, or capability-token change is a POSSIBLE breaking change — require an explicit callout. Do not assert sibling components remain compatible.

Signing, arming, attestation, watch, outbox, capability-token, and directive-envelope paths are fail-closed by doctrine. Flag any change that widens a gate, adds a bypass env var, removes re-verification, or converts a hard error into a warning/success default.

Fail-closed sibling-guard doctrine: a route registered without the guard its siblings already possess is a security regression. Flag (1) new/changed management or watch-mutation routes that omit admin_token_matches / ArmPrincipals::authenticate / equivalent while siblings keep it, (2) debug introspection routes without GATEWAY_DEBUG_* env gating at registration time, (3) removal or bypass of the UDS global_rate_limit layer, (4) nginx locations that newly expose previously UDS-internal probes without an auth gate, (5) auth bypass env vars (COUNCIL_DEV_NO_AUTH and kin) that widen beyond localhost/dev. Do not accept canary-tenant alone as authorization for policy mutation.
Public security claims must not outrun docs/security-claims-vs-reality.md. Flag wording that upgrades a Partially-enforced or Documented-gap claim to Enforced without code receipts in the same PR.

For CI wiring, prove executable reachability. Filename mentions, path-filter inclusion, comments, echo/heredoc fixture text, and grep subject strings are not execution. Flag tests or scripts that are only path-filter triggers or mentioned in non-command position without a real workflow/make invocation path.

For refactors and deletions, look for remaining callers, alternate entry points, and behavior-characterization coverage before declaring a path unused. Flag removal of a surface that is still reachable via make targets, CI jobs, Tauri commands, or Lua routes.

Keep source, test, build, package, install, acceptance, and publication claims distinct (docs/release-runbook.md). make check / ship-check prove source only — not installed-app, Touch ID arm, notarization, or publication. Flag language that collapses these tiers.

Vocabulary for architecture prose only. Prefer Worker (ephemeral) or Sentinel (continuous) over vague 'AI agent' for product roles. Flag a Sentinel described as firing on a wall-clock schedule regardless of observed state (generic always-on/heartbeat scheduling). Do NOT flag legitimate protocol or ops terms: outbox lease heartbeat routes/operations, writer-claim heartbeat TTLs, or CI always-on required checks (see docs/architecture.md, docs/surface-map.md, docs/security-claims-vs-reality.md).
